'''Alba-16''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the planet was in the midst of a violent civil war. [[Nuuta]], one of the [[Memory wipe/Legends|renewed]] [[Phindian/Legends|Phindians]], was sent to Alba as punishment for fighting against the [[Syndicat]] on [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]]. The use of the world as a penal camp was ended by the efforts of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After the rise of the Empire, the planet had little real Imperial presence, lacking a garrison. Ex-Jedi and fugitive [[Ferus Olin]] went to a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Alba-16 following his escape from [[Dontamo]]'s prison facility.

==Behind the scenes==
Originally mentioned in [[Jude Watson]]'s ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]'', Alba was noted as having been engaged in a civil war. While the next mention of the world denotes it as Alba-16, the planet is placed in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], near the world [[Dontamo]]. With the release of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the world is [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to be located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories.
